project_info.name: Daleel Pets
project_info.market: Saudi Arabia B2B (Store owners, buyers, market analysts)
project_info.tone: Premium, data-driven, modern, dark, precise, fast-feeling
project_info.references: Linear.app meets Hex.tech meets Saudi fintech dashboard

spacing_and_layout.grid_system: MODE B: THE CONTROL ROOM GRID (Tight gap-4 to gap-6, dense data density).
spacing_and_layout.container_padding: p-6 or p-8 for glassmorphic cards.
spacing_and_layout.border_radius: rounded-2xl for main cards, rounded-full for buttons and pills.

buttons.primary: rounded-full bg-[#00D4B4] text-[#0A0F1E] font-semibold hover:bg-[#00E5C3] hover:shadow-[0_0_20px_rgba(0,212,180,0.4)] transition-all px-6 py-2.5
buttons.secondary: rounded-full bg-transparent border border-white/10 text-white hover:bg-white/5 transition-all px-6 py-2.5

badges.tier: rounded-full px-2.5 py-0.5 text-xs font-mono font-bold bg-[#F59E0B]/10 text-[#F59E0B] border border-[#F59E0B]/20

charts.tooltip: bg-[#111827] border border-white/10 text-white rounded-lg shadow-xl

login.layout: Split screen (50/50). Left: Animated hero graphic with glassmorphic overlay. Right: Login form centered.
login.features: Bilingual toggle, electric teal primary button, glowing input focus states.

dashboard.layout: Hero KPI row (4 metrics), followed by charts and latest data table.
dashboard.features: Glowing metric cards (monospaced numbers), teal/amber accent mini sparklines.

stores_registry.features: Tier 4 badges, crawl status indicators, hover-lift micro-animations.

insights.layout: Bento grid with varied span sizes.
insights.features: Price wars leaderboard, top sellers, restock alerts. Heavy chart usage.

scanner.layout: Opportunity card grid. Focus on quick wins.
scanner.features: Highlight undercut margins in Success Green, Overpriced in Warning Amber.

alerts.layout: Clean list view inside a single glassmorphic panel.
alerts.features: Event feed with colored severity dots.

market_digest.layout: Modal / Newsletter style centered reading view.
market_digest.features: Text-heavy but highly legible. Generous line-height, clear typography.

settings.layout: Tabbed layout within a main glass card.
settings.features: Credential vault with Tier 4 encryption verify visual.

accessibility_and_testing.testing: All interactive elements MUST use data-testid (e.g., data-testid='login-submit-button').
accessibility_and_testing.motion: Respect prefers-reduced-motion for all hover and entrance animations.

saas_hero_bg.description: Abstract 3D glassmorphic background for dark mode SaaS with teal and amber light streaks.
saas_hero_bg.usage: Use as the background for the Login page left split-screen or main dashboard hero background with low opacity.

market_data_bg.description: Abstract glowing data visualization background with dark tech theme.
market_data_bg.usage: Use in the Empty States, Market Digest header, or as a subtle overlay pattern for the Settings Vault.

tech_logos.usage: Generic placeholder tech logo for stores or integration examples in Settings.
Logitech logo for tech equipment store examples.

instructions_to_main_agent: Install Phosphor Icons or Lucide for tech-heavy, precise dashboard iconography.
Implement pure dark mode. Do NOT include a light mode toggle. The platform is dark-first and dark-only.
All cards must strictly follow the glassmorphism rules: `#111827` at 80% opacity with `backdrop-blur-xl` and `border-white/10`.
Data tables must have monospaced numerical values and right-aligned numeric columns.
Avoid standard Shadcn outlines. Customize Shadcn primitives (like inputs and selects) to match the dark glassmorphic theme with teal focus rings (`focus:ring-[#00D4B4]/50`).
The Sidebar must have a subtle background `#0D1321`. Active links must display a prominent left-border `#00D4B4` and an inner shadow glow.
Include empty states using the 'market_data_bg' with a heavy blur and an informative text block.
Ensure the OTP Banner uses the Warning Amber (#F59E0B) with high-contrast text.
No plain text placeholders for images, use the provided media URLs.
